'''Hordem Molec''' was a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] who was the son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] and older brother of Prince [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]]. He died sometime after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
